# Version of this source for builds from a copy without .git (the Windows PC).
# `git archive` fills in the placeholders below (export-subst in .gitattributes);
# in a git checkout they stay unfilled and CMake asks git instead. Do not edit.
revision=$Format:%H$
describe=$Format:%(describe:tags,match=v*)$
refs=$Format:%D$
date=$Format:%ad$
